analysis.reasoning: The paper describes iterative pruning that repeats until a targeted sparsity is reached. The cited artifact code exposes a fixed --n_iter defaulting to 3 and run.sh does not override it; the shown arguments include no target-sparsity stopping criterion. This supports the claim that the artifact uses fixed iterations rather than target-sparsity termination.
analysis.would_confirm: Inspect the iterative_SA.py pruning loop to verify it only iterates range(args.n_iter) and never breaks on a target sparsity.
